meta.source: OpenPDK sky130_spectre AC impedance verification (results/COMPARE_RC.md, 2026-11-19, tt 27C)
notes: cap_mim_m3_1 and cap_mim_m3_2 measured 5x5 and 10x10 um testbenches all at z_10khz = 169.54 dBOhm -> C = 1/(2*pi*1e4*10^(169.54/20)) = 53.0 fF. The identical values across geometries indicate the testbench parametrization collapsed to one C - treat cap_per_area as an order-of-magnitude estimate and verify the wanted geometry with a dedicated run before final Cp sizing.
MOM-style fingered caps (crtmom equivalents) are not part of the transcribed set; Cp realized as a square MIM (w=l=sqrt(C/cap_per_area)) or an ideal capacitor for first-pass verification.
